item_holdout_study.title: Fair Disjoint True Item Holdout Study (3 Cohorts, N=416 Cold-Target Users)
item_holdout_study.evidence_rule: STRONG only if Group (a) NDCG@10 lower CI bound > 2x cold-only random baseline AND Group (b) paired difference CI does not show a significant loss (hi95 >= 0). MODERATE if Group (a) lower CI bound > 1x cold-only random. Otherwise WEAK.
item_holdout_study.evidence_statement: Evidence is WEAK: Group (a) lower 95% bound (0.0239) exceeds the cold-only random baseline (0.0228), and warm-user damage is statistically significant (Group b paired Delta = -0.0044 [-0.0050, -0.0038]).

evidence_details.rule: STRONG only if Group (a) NDCG@10 lower CI bound > 2x cold-only random baseline AND Group (b) paired difference CI does not show a significant loss (hi95 >= 0). MODERATE if Group (a) lower CI bound > 1x cold-only random. Otherwise WEAK.

sparse_targets_study.limitations_note: Masking the target item ID embedding simulates a brand-new item cold-start. This is a simulated offline ablation and not a true prospective trial.

simulated_new_items_study.limitations_note: This is a simulation: the content encoders saw item metadata during training. Rating and review proxies were neutralized to standardized 0.
